paragraphs: R. Chiyya. “R. Chiyya taught before Rava, etc.; he said to him, etc.; he said to him: ‘Why did you not study?’” A marginal gloss printed with Rashi explains: why did you not learn before Rabbah? You would then know as I do. “Many times I taught it before the Master”—who was this? Rava—“and he told me, etc.”: Keritot 25a, near the end. I do not know who this Rabbi Chiyya is. Perhaps he is bar Rav Huna, mentioned above, who was a student of Abaye and Rava. Yet R. Chiyya bar Rav Huna is called Rav Chiyya, whereas this one is called Rabbi Chiyya. “Who was this? Rava”—so too in Birkat HaZevach—makes no sense. From Rashi it appears that it should read “Who was this? Rabbah.” Also Berakhot 34b: “R. Chiyya said: Rav Safra said.”
